info.title: BNJM allocation test data (subset of Znode Web API v1 and Znode Custom Table API v1)

post.summary: Insert record in custom table dynamically.

parameters.name: tableKey
parameters.description: Unique Table Key (maximum 100 characters, no spaces or special characters)

requestBody.description: The body containing an array of custom table fields and values in JSON format. Each object in the array represents a row with key-value pairs where the keys are the column names and values are the data for that column.

201.description: Created (Indicates that the request is successfully executed and the response body return the data in CustomTableBulkResponse model.)

404.description: Not Found (This status code indicates that the server cannot find the requested resource.)

400.description: Bad Request (The request contain invalid Data.)

500.description: Server Error (Indicates that an error occurred on the server.)

delete.description: This API endpoint Deletes the list of associated Custom Table Data.

DisableCentralLogin.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether central login functionality is disabled for the current context.
When set to `true`, users will not be able to log in through the central authentication system.

IsMultiFactorAuthenticationEnabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether 2FA is enabled for the admin console.

Status.description: A value indicating whether the user account is currently active or deactivated.

uniqueColumnValue.description: The value of the unique column. If any table does not contain unique column, then it will return row number instead.

errorMessage.description: Error message if anything fails during execution.
